subject: Request: Sandbox credits & short trial extension — SDK blocker
messages:
From: Julian Harper <julian@finedge.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Sandbox credits & short trial extension — SDK blocker
Attachments: sdk-error-log.txt, mutual-action-plan.pdf

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from the integration team at FinEdge — we hit a hard blocker with the analytics SDK the vendor shipped. When our connector runs against the sandbox it crashes intermittently (segfault) during the initial handshake; attached is a short error log. Our engineers have a suspected socket leak in the vendor SDK that prevents us from exercising the Redwood inference flows end-to-end.

This has knocked our timeline out by ~10 business days. We were hoping for a two-week extension on the sandbox/trial window and a small credit top-up so we can continue smoke tests once the vendor patch lands. Specifically: 10,000 token sandbox credit and an extension to 2026-06-19.

We attached a one-page mutual action plan that shows the remaining integration steps and a proposed schedule if we get the extension. Can you advise next steps and what information you need for approvals?

Appreciate the help — we really like the latency profile and want to get the connector validated for our pilot.

— Julian
Julian Harper
Head of Integrations, FinEdge
julian@finedge.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Harper <julian@finedge.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Sandbox credits & short trial extension — SDK blocker

Julian — thanks for the clear note and for the attachments.

We can escalate this for a short-term sandbox top-up and extension while you triage with the vendor, but I need a couple quick things to move through approvals:
- A rough ETA from your side for vendor patch rollout (even a range is fine).
- Which Redwood flows you need to validate first (generation, streaming, embeddings).
- Confirm whether customer data is in the sandbox or test-only data.

Cc'ing Dev and Ethan to confirm the technical ask and recommended credit amount from an engineering POV. If you can reply with the ETA and which flows you're validating, I'll start the approval path.

If helpful, we can also set a quick 20-min triage call today — I have a slot at 3:00pm PT.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Julian Harper <julian@finedge.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Sandbox credits & short trial extension — SDK blocker
Attachments: triage-notes.md

Kimberly / Julian — quick technical readout after looking over the log and reproducing locally:
- Root cause appears to be a socket reuse bug in the vendor analytics SDK that manifests under our connection multiplexing; it doesn't seem to be Redwood failure.
- Repro rate ~70% on our dev harness. Fix from vendor expected but we estimate 10–12 engineering hours of work on their side + 2 hours integration smoke on FinEdge once patched.
- To avoid repeated back-and-forth, recommend granting a slightly larger credit (12,000–15,000 tokens) so FinEdge can run full end-to-end validation (generation + embeddings + streaming) once vendor fixes. Two-week extension should be sufficient.

If you want, I included a couple quick triage notes in the attachment. From an operations perspective, we don't need to provision anything special — just the sandbox credits and the extended expiry.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Approved: FinEdge sandbox extension + credits (HS-45321)

Kimberly — reviewed the thread and Dev's triage notes. Approving temporary support to keep the pilot moving:
- Grant 14,000 sandbox tokens credited to the FinEdge trial account (DEAL-7893).
- Extend trial expiry to 2026-06-19 (two-week extension from their original expiry).
- Please add the mutual-action-plan.pdf to the account record in HubSpot (HS-45321) and update the account notes with the triage summary.

Kimberly, please confirm once credits are applied and send a short confirmation email to Julian with the new expiry and quota. Also include a brief note that if more runway is needed after the vendor patch, we'll reassess.

Thanks for moving fast on this.

— Rachel Kim
